services.notes: Airtable REST API. Authorization: Bearer {token}. Rate limit: 5 req/sec per base. The {baseId} is the Airtable base (application) ID, {tableId} is the table name or ID.
Asana REST API. Authorization: Bearer {personal_access_token}. All responses wrap data in a 'data' envelope. GIDs are globally unique identifiers (strings of digits).

BambooHR Human Resources API v1. Authenticates via HTTP Basic (API key as username, 'x' as password) or OAuth 2.0. All paths begin with /api/v1/. Employee fields are requested by name using a comma-separated list. Tabular data (job history, compensation, etc.) is accessed through the tables sub-resource.

Basecamp 3 REST API. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {access_token}. The account ID is part of the base URL path. Projects are called 'buckets'. Each project has a todoset which contains todolists. Todos are created inside todolists.

Buffer Publishing API v1. OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token required. Profiles = social media channels (Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, etc.). Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded for POST. Rate limit: 60 requests/minute per user.
Canva Connect API. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. Rate limits vary per endpoint.
Confluence Cloud REST API v2. Authorization: Bearer {api_token} or Basic base64(email:token). spaceId is the numeric ID of the Confluence space.

Facebook Conversions API (Server-Side API). Sends web events from your server directly to Facebook. Requires a Pixel ID and a System User Access Token. Events are sent to /{pixel_id}/events. Standard event names: Purchase, Lead, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, CompleteRegistration, Search, Contact, Subscribe, FindLocation, Schedule, StartTrial, SubmitApplication, AddPaymentInfo, AddToWishlist, CustomizeProduct, Donate, PageView.

Facebook Lead Ads API via the Graph API. Lead Ads let you collect contact info from users via an instant form. To get started: create a lead form on a Page, then create an Ad that references the form. Leads submitted through the form are retrievable via the form's leads edge. Requires pages_manage_ads, ads_management, and leads_retrieval permissions.
Facebook Graph API for Pages. Requires a Page Access Token with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement permissions. Requests go to graph.facebook.com/v25.0/{page-id}/...

Google Ads API (REST). Requires Authorization: Bearer {token}, developer-token header, and optionally login-customer-id for manager accounts. customerId is the Google Ads customer ID (digits only, no dashes). Most read operations use GAQL (Google Ads Query Language) via the googleAds:search endpoint.

Google Drive API v3. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {access_token}. Files and folders are both represented as File resources. Use mimeType 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' to create a folder. The q parameter supports the Drive query language for filtering results.

Instagram Graph API (Content Publishing) via graph.facebook.com. Requires a Facebook Developer App with instagram_content_publish and instagram_basic permissions plus a long-lived User Access Token. Publishing uses a two-step flow: create a media container, then publish it. Rate limits: 400 containers per 24-hour rolling period; 50 published posts per 24-hour moving period.
Jira Cloud REST API v3. Authorization: Bearer {api_token} or Basic base64(email:token). Issue keys look like 'PROJ-123'. Project keys are short uppercase identifiers like 'PROJ'.
LinkedIn API v2. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. Resources are identified by URNs (e.g. urn:li:person:{id}, urn:li:organization:{id}).

LinkedIn Marketing API (REST/v2). Used for managing LinkedIn Ads audiences (Matched Audiences / DMP Segments), sending conversion events, and creating reports. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {access_token} and LinkedIn-Version header. Audiences are called DMP Segments. Contacts are identified by hashed email.

LinkedIn Conversions API (CAPI). A server-to-server integration that lets you send conversion events directly to LinkedIn without relying on browser-based tracking. Requires Authorization: Bearer {access_token} and LinkedIn-Version header. Use this API to send conversion events such as purchases, sign-ups, and other valuable actions that happen on your server.

Monday.com API v2. All requests are POST to the same endpoint with a GraphQL query in the body. Authorization: Bearer {api_token}. board_id and item_id are integers (pass as strings). column_id is the column's internal ID (e.g. 'status', 'date4', 'text').
Notion REST API. Authorization: Bearer {integration_token}. Notion-Version: 2025-09-03 header required. parent_id can be a page ID or database ID. Page IDs are UUIDs (with or without dashes).

Pipefy GraphQL API. Authorization: Bearer {personal_access_token}. All operations are modeled as REST-style endpoints that map to GraphQL mutations/queries internally. pipe_id is optional context for most operations.

QuickBooks Online Accounting API. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens. All entity URLs follow the pattern /v3/company/{companyId}/{entity}. Every update must supply the record's current SyncToken to prevent stale-write conflicts. Deletes are performed via POST with ?operation=delete. Queries use a structured syntax (resembling SQL) posted to /v3/company/{companyId}/query.

Recruitee ATS API for managing recruitment workflows. Uses OAuth2 Bearer tokens passed in the Authorization header. Every endpoint path is namespaced under /c/{company_id}/. The API enforces a ceiling of 1000 calls per minute for each token. Each token operates with the same access level as the user account that created it.
Trello REST API. Authentication via query params: key={apiKey}&token={userToken}. Board IDs, card IDs, and list IDs are 24-character alphanumeric strings.
Twilio REST API. Authentication: HTTP Basic with AccountSid as username and AuthToken as password. Phone numbers must be in E.164 format (+15551234567). SMS Body max 1600 chars.
X (Twitter) API v2. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. OAuth 2.0 Bearer Token for app-only auth; OAuth 1.0a or OAuth 2.0 PKCE for user-context endpoints (likes, follows, post tweet).

Wave Accounting GraphQL API. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens. All operations are sent as POST requests to /graphql/public with a JSON body containing a query or mutation string and optional variables. Results use Relay-style cursor pagination with edges/pageInfo. Wave uses PUT-style create semantics via GraphQL mutations. Scopes follow resource:operation pattern (e.g., invoice:write, customer:read). Most entity queries are nested under a business node.

Xero Accounting API. Authentication uses OAuth 2.0. Every request requires a xero-tenant-id header identifying the target organisation. IMPORTANT: Xero uses non-standard HTTP methods -- PUT creates new records, POST updates existing records. Supports If-Modified-Since header for incremental sync. Common query params: where (filter expression), order (sort), page (pagination, 100 per page). Unit amounts default to 2 decimal places; set unitdp=4 for four.
Zoom Meeting API v2. All requests require Authorization: Bearer {token}. Meeting IDs are numeric. Use 'me' as userId for the authenticated user.
